lines.text: Dinah, Leah's daughter, visits the daughters of the land, and Shechem son of Hamor takes her by force.
Hamor asks Jacob to give Dinah to Shechem as a wife and offers that the families intermarry.
Jacob's sons answer deceitfully and say every male in the city must be baptized like them.
Three days later, Simeon and Benjamin kill every male in the city, including Hamor and Shechem.
Jacob says his sons have made him a stench to the Canaanites and Perizzites, the people of this land.
